verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is a web crawling service, so resuming a crashed crawl from a checkpoint is a fair question for it. The evidence shows whole-site crawling, async batch scraping, and webhooks for crawl progress, but nothing documents checkpointing, saving crawl state, or resuming an interrupted crawl. Progress webhooks are an adjacent feature and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can resume a crashed deep crawl from a saved checkpoint instead of restarting from scratch
